{{Quote|You understand me, Admiral Andor?''"<br />"''I understand my ''duty'', off-worlder! If this is some Jedi trick, it will not prevent me from carrying out my orders.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Andor|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
'''Andor''' was a [[Themian]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Themian Fleet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the Republic's [[Mission to Themis|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]], Andor ordered the Themian Fleet to destroy the [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and reported it to Themis's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lumon]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Admiral Andor to Prince Lumon. My prince, the invading craft has been destroyed! The mining base is secure!|Andor, to Lumon|<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />}}
[[File:Mission_to_Themis.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi requested Andor to fire on his starfighter (far right) precisely on time.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Themian]] Andor served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Themian Fleet]]. During the Republic's [[Mission to Themis|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Themis]] to negotiate rights to its [[Themis moon|moon's]] [[Themis moon mining base|mines]] of explosive [[Ore/Legends|ore]], the Separatist [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Thax]] sabotaged [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]] with a [[Thax's sabotage droid|droid]] planted by [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Thax's agent|agent]] in an attempt to discredit the Republic in the negotiations. As his [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] approached the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Kenobi contacted Andor, who answered that they would not hesitate to destroy the fighter as ordered by Themis's [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lumon]]. Believing he was not making himself clear, Kenobi requested Andor to destroy his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] precisely on [[Time/Legends|time]], to the [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] surprise. As the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] opened fire on his starfighter, Kenobi timed the [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] and escaped the destruction.<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />

Andor informed Lumon that the fleet had destroyed Kenobi's fighter. Meanwhile, Kenobi presented Lumon evidence of Thax's treachery: a scrap of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had sabotaged his vessel. After Thax threatened to kill him and was disarmed, Lumon decided Themis would join the Republic.<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />

==Personality and traits==
Andor had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin, and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The admiral was a loyal officer who carried out their orders.<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />

==Equipment==
Andor wore a dark blue and maroon [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]], including dark blue [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andor appeared in the [[2011]] comic strip "[[Runaway Starfighter]]," written by [[Mike W. Barr]], pencilled by [[Andres Ponce]], and published in the comic ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.24|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.24]]''.<ref name="Runaway Starfighter" />
